works.title: Aura
works.description: Software tool for AI-assisted writing with configurable framework selection, multi-stage pipeline testing, and visual interface design. Planned as open-source for teaching writers how to use AI for fiction. Includes installation script, model bucket auto-population, and playwright removal.
works.quote: I need to have a freeform discussion about where I'm at with developing Aura

works.title: Donald Trump as Andrew Jackson
works.description: Political-economic essay analyzing Trump's credit card rate cap proposal as a direct parallel to Andrew Jackson's 1832 Second Bank veto, with detailed comparative rhetoric analysis and planned imagery concepts. Part of a planned series including a follow-up on credit crunch economic consequences.
works.quote: the post I'm going to write today is about how Donald Trump just became Andrew Jackson
